outcomes.outcome: INPUT and FORWARD drop by default and OUTPUT is left open (the class sets no OUTPUT policy); a port no rule allows is dropped for any other host
ICMP and SSH are let in from any host
traffic to 127.0.0.0/8 arriving on another interface is rejected (rule 002)

uncovered.why: the same rule in firewall_secure_extra's set (2026-11-18) counted none of 3 hand-built frames from the peer to 127.0.0.1 through the node's NIC, with route_localnet 0 and with it set to 1 (unexplained); no lab path is known that brings such a frame to INPUT
uncovered.lifted_by: capability: a frame path that reaches INPUT with a 127.0.0.0/8 destination on a non-loopback interface (route_localnet 1 did not suffice)
uncovered.evidence: firewall_secure.yml rule-002 row; the lead in escalations/firewall_secure_extra.behaviour.md

outcomes.outcome: replies to the node's own outbound connections are accepted despite the INPUT drop (rule 003, related and established)
rules Puppet does not manage are purged at the next agent run
the emergency flush script is installed, clears every rule when run, and the next agent run rebuilds the firewall
the running rules are saved for the next boot
